column1: # b07_player (3F50 player actor, 9D50 NPCs). Quest 64 refs: decomp include/33D0.h
# (PlayerMainData: HP/MP/agi/def, *XP counters, elements[4], exp) and symbol_addrs.txt
# (gSaveSpawnLocationTbl, gNPCData, gMessageBuffer, gNPCName); twins via us_map.tsv.
# Pad bits of D_80092C86 (pressed buttons) are the libultra ones: A 0x8000, B 0x4000, Z 0x2000, R 0x10, C 0xF.
# Player state table: D_8004DCB0[PlayerState.unk0], called once per frame from func_80003BE0.

column3: called once from 1870's boot init list; DMAs ROM 869620..86F6F0 to 80206000, copies default stats D_80055D44 into D_8007A9D0 and links them to D_8007AA08 (the player); Q64 twin 800027D0 fills gPlayerMainData
called on every area load (1870, 3B40, 36E60); puts D_8007AA08 at the spawn x/z/rot D_8007A98C/990/994, snaps to the floor (func_800107F0), picks the entry state from the entrance kind D_8007A998

looks up map/submap D_800842BC/C0 in the 17-entry D_80056088 (Q64 gSaveSpawnLocationTbl: map, submap, x, z, yrot) and copies x/z/rot to the spawn vars Player_Spawn reads; called by 1870 after a death (D_8004DCA0 & 0x800)
called once per frame from 1870's game loop; reads input (A/Z interact, R, C spell keys), looks for NPC/chest/examine/encounter targets, then calls the state function D_8004DCB0[p->unk0]

in 1870's draw list (skipped while D_8004DCA0 & 0x10000); applies the light slot, loads the anim, draws the player model (Anim_DrawModel) and advances its frame (Anim_AdvanceFrame), then queues its floor shadow (Shadow_Queue) at the floor height under the tracked node

called from both encounter starts (Battle_TryStartRandomEncounter, Battle_StartBossEncounter); zeroes the exp/stone rewards D_8007A9B4/B8, sets the move radius unkC from agility (stats +0xC), the element-level sum, enters state 3 with battle anim 0x12

state table slots 0, 1, 2; analog stick D_80092C81/82 with a +-8 dead zone, rotated by the camera angle, zeroed while locked/in another turn; dispatches idle/walk/run (func_80006040/80006168/8000665C) and plays the run footstep sound
state 3 (set by many callers with a frame count in unk4): stands still and returns to state 0 when the timer runs out, clearing actor flags 0x3
state 4, entered from walk/run when the stick is released at speed > 1 (anim 0xF): keeps moving with velocity damped by 0.68 a frame until the timer ends. "Brake" is a reading of that.

state 5, entered from Player_TakeDamage (anim 8, timer from char data); at the end, if HP (stats +0x4) is 0 it enters state 6 with the death anim 9 and sets the respawn-at-save flags (D_8004DCA0 |= 0x880), else returns to state 0
state 6, entered only from Player_StateHurt when HP is 0; moves by the death animation's motion and moves the camera (D_80085E48) at a set frame
state 7, entered from Player_Update after Npc_StartTalk; waits until the text window closes (D_80090450 == 0), then Npc_EndTalk and back to state 0 (sound 0x3B if the NPC gave an item, unk8 & 0x40)
state 8, entered on area entry/exit (Player_Spawn, Player_StartAreaExit): moves by the fixed per-frame step unk12C/unk130 (20 or 40 units rotated by the facing) until the timer ends, no input

states 13 and 16 (16 = the follow-up hit, damage * 0.5); at the end of the timer rolls Player_RollMeleeHit, deals Player_CalcMeleeDamage to the target via Enemy_TakeDamage with a streak burst, else Enemy_PlayMissEffect; then ends the turn
state 14, entered from Player_StartCastSpell; when the delay unk124 runs out calls Magic_CreateCastEffect(actor, spell id unk122, ...), then waits for the cast anim and ends the turn (Battle_EndTurn)
state 9, entered from Player_StartObjectExit: steps toward a point beside the exit's map object (D_8007C290) and turns to unk134, then state 10 with the object animation unk6 and sound 0x1A
state 10: velocity comes from the current animation (Player_GetAnimMotion) until the timer ends, then restores the facing unk138; used for the exit/entrance animations

state 11, entered from Player_StartOpenChest; at frame 0x20 adds item unk11C to the inventory (Item_AddToInventory) and shows the got-item message (Item_BuildMessage, Text_OpenWindow). "Chest" is a reading: an object that gives an item when opened (b01 Chest_*)
state 12, entered from Player_StartUseItem; at the end calls the item's use handler Item_ApplyEffect(item unk11C, actor) and ends the turn

state 15, entered from Player_Update when battle flag D_8008BE52 & 8 is set (after the exp/stone rewards are added); turns back to the pre-battle facing unk134 and restores the map BGM (func_8002A744)
state 17, entered from Player_Update when facing an examine point (TextSpot_FindInFront, message loaded by TextSpot_LoadMessage); opens the text window (Text_OpenWindow(1)) and waits until it closes
called by Player_StateMove for state 0: no velocity; stick input switches to walk (state 1) or run (state 2, speed > 1.5); else keeps the idle anim D_8007A910

called by Player_StateMove for state 1: turns toward the stick (max 45 deg/frame), speed up to 2 units, walk anim 1 with speed-scaled rate; switches to run above 1.5, to brake (state 4) or idle on release
called by Player_StateMove for state 2: like Player_MoveWalk with run anim 2 and slower acceleration; back to walk under 1.0, to brake (state 4) on release
loads and applies the actor's anim entry (func_80020214) and returns the anim offset (-unk44, unk4C) rotated by the facing; callers use it as the frame's velocity

clamps the step to the battle move circles (D_8008BE64/68, D_8008BE5C/60) in battle, pushes out of objects (Player_PushOutOfObjects), then moves via the floor query func_800107F0 and stores position, floor normal and floor type
returns 1 + index of the first visible NPC (D_8007ABB0 list into D_8007ABF0) within 15 units (25 with flag 0x1000) in front of the player, or 0; result goes to Npc_StartTalk
pushes the move step out of the circles of the D_8007C030 actors, the visible NPCs and the D_8007C2A8 cylinders (radius sum, first hit only)
switch on the floor type (unk62 >> 6 & 7) from the floor query: type 1 calls Player_TakeDamage(1, ...) when the counter unk128 is 0; type 2 moves the player along the floor normal

called by 1870 when the exit trigger func_80011770 fires (which fills D_80084300 via func_80011A10); switches on the exit kind (unkC >> 8 & 0xF): auto-walk (state 8), object exit (Player_StartObjectExit), or wait; sets the fade timer D_8007A174
exit kinds 2/3 from Player_StartAreaExit: starts the animation of map object D_8007C290[unk10] (func_8000F50C) and either plays anim 0x1A (kind 3) or walks to its side (state 9)
called by Player_Update after func_800139EC opens the object found by func_80013808; anim 0x1C/0x1D, state 11 for 0x5A frames. "Chest": see Player_StateOpenChest
called from 25B20 after an item's use check passes (D_8004F4A0[item->unk2]); stores the item in unk11C, state 12, anim 0x17/0x16
DMAs the ROM range D_80055F98[actor.unk52] (current anim id, Q64 PlayerPosData.currentAnimID) to 0x80200000, cached in a static so it only loads on change; always passed the player actor

in battle: returns 1 + index of the first live monster (D_8007C050 into D_8007B908) within reach in front of the player and at a reachable height, or 0; stored in unk2, used by Player_StartMeleeAttack
called by Player_Update on A/Z in battle with a target (unk2): state 13, anim 0xA, faces the target monster, battle camera on the player (func_80015F44)
returns get_rand(100) < chance, chance = 100*A/(A + (M+7)/8) from the player's and the monster's +0x86 values; Player_StateMeleeAttack deals damage only if it returns 1

returns the hit's damage from the element-level sum unk108 (uneven levels capped at a quarter, D_8004DCFC factor), 1/32 critical (1/4 with all elements at 50) that shows message D_8004F760, halved with unk84 & 1

called by monster attacks (AEA0) and spells (17360) with (damage, flags, attacker); damage x1.5 when hit from behind (> 135 deg off the facing), scales by the attacker's +0x84 against defense unk10C, subtracts from HP (stats +0x4), adds HP/def XP (+0x28/+0x2E), enters state 5

called when a monster's hit roll fails (Enemy_StateMeleeAttack, then agility XP +1) or a spell misses the player (17360); state 3, anim 7, the miss popup (Hud_ShowActorPopup, as Enemy_PlayMissEffect), sound 0x17. "Dodge" is a reading of that

returns 1 unless the player is locked (actor flag 1), exiting (D_8004DCA0 & 0x80) or the battle is won; in battle also needs the player's turn (no 0x202), no active spell (func_80017AB0) and D_8008BE54 == 0; gates R and spell input in Player_Update
C buttons append an element (0-3) to unk11D (max 3, rejected when func_800168F0 says invalid), B removes the last, A/Z with a valid spell (func_800167B0) stores its id in unk122 and returns 1
called by Player_Update when Player_HandleSpellInput returns 1: subtracts the MP cost D_800C186E[count] from MP (stats +0x8), picks the cast anim from the spell def D_800C185C, state 14
in battle, before ending the turn (func_8001FC14): adds the distance from the turn's start point D_8008BE64/68 to D_8007A988 and gives 1 agility XP (stats +0x2C, Q64 agiXP) per 35 units

called each move frame: walking gives agility XP outside battle; raises HP/MP/agility/defense (stats +4..+0xE) when their XP (+0x28..+0x2E, Q64 HPXP..defXP) reaches the D_80055F0C cost, and the spirit level (+0x34) from exp (+0x10) against D_80055D7C

column1: # 9D50: NPCs (loaded only where D_800842E8 & 1, the random-encounter flag, is clear), D_8007ABF0[16] (Q64 gNPCData), defs from the area's list.

column3: called by 1870 after Player_Spawn on area load: resets the NPC count D_8007ABA4 and, unless D_800842E8 & 1, loads the area files (func_80009764) and spawns the area's NPC defs (Npc_SpawnForArea)

called once per frame from 1870 after Player_Update; per-NPC state machine: 0 idle (wander type starts walking, max 3 at once), 1 walk (Npc_Move), 2 turn toward the player while talking, 3 turn back to the home angle

in 1870's draw list: draws each NPC within 300 units (bilinear filter under ~141), its model and shadow, and rebuilds the visible list D_8007ABB0 / count D_8007ABA8 used by the collision and talk checks
fills D_8007ABF0 from the def list for defs whose area matches D_800842C0: position/angle from the def, floor snap, idle anim, home position, flag 1 -> wide talk radius (0x1000)
moves an NPC by (dx, dz) after Npc_PushOutOfObjects, then snaps it to the floor with func_800107F0 and stores position and floor normal
pushes an NPC's step out of the player's circle, the other visible NPCs' circles and the D_8007C2A8 cylinders (first hit only); NPC twin of Player_PushOutOfObjects

called by Player_Update with the NPC from Player_FindNpcToTalk: state 2 (turns toward the player unless def flag 2), picks the message by the def's type (item given unless already in the D_8008C9B8 inventory; Boss_IsDefeated; type 6 a two-choice prompt) and loads it (Npc_LoadMessage)
called from Player_StateTalk when the text window closes: wanderers go back to idle with a random delay, others turn back to their home angle (state 3)
DMAs the message at ROM D_D2E2F0 + offset into D_8007B430 (0x4B0, Q64 gMessageBuffer) and copies the NPC's name into D_8007B8E0 (0x20, Q64 gNPCName), 0xFF if it has none
copies a message already in RAM into D_8007B430 and NPC arg0's name into D_8007B8E0, as Npc_LoadMessage does from ROM; called by Npc_InitArea for an area-entry message
